text: Hello! Happy weekend! Welcome to your weather report for Sunday, November 22. Sunday. A slow and cosy sort of day. Shanghai is going to be overcast today. The high will be 16 degrees, and the low will be 6 degrees. It will feel just right out there. Rain is very unlikely today. Did you know today is day 326 of the year? There are 39 days to go until the new one. Keep an eye on the sky. The clouds might break and let the sun through. Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be cloudy, reaching 18 degrees. Something to think about: what would you put in a treasure box? And that's it for today's weather. Have a lovely time!
